title: Thai-Style Low-Fat Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Thai-inspired dish made with juicy chicken breast, savory vegetables, and a hint of stir-fry flavor. This recipe is perfect for a low-fat dinner option.
instructions: Heat the low-fat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the bell pepper, mushrooms, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and add the thai stir-fry sauce, fat-free soy sauce, and green onions.
Stir-fry everything together for about 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the chicken and vegetables hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional green onions, if desired.
